issue_context.title: systemd-networkd: Support multipath routing
issue_context.body:
Hi there,

I'm trying to configure network multipath routing, but it looks the nexthops default route cannot be set up with systemd-networkd.

Here is the files in /systemd/network :
`net.network`
```
[Match]
Name=en*

[Network]
VLAN=inet.11
VLAN=inet.22
```
`inet.11.netdev`
```
[NetDev]
Name=inet.11
Kind=vlan

[VLAN]
Id=11
```

`inet.22.netdev`
```
[NetDev]
Name=inet.22
Kind=vlan

[VLAN]
Id=22
```

`inet.11.network`
```
[Match]
Name=inet.11

[Network]
DHCP=no
Address=192.168.11.43/24

[Route]
Gateway=192.168.11.1
Table=11

[RoutingPolicyRule]
From=192.168.11.0/24
Table=11
```

`inet.22.network`
```
[Match]
Name=inet.22

[Network]
DHCP=no
Address=192.168.22.43/24

[Route]
Gateway=192.168.22.2
Table=22

[RoutingPolicyRule]
From=192.168.22.0/24
Table=22
```

And the part that cannot be set up : 
```
$ ip route add default nexthop via 192.168.11.1 dev inet.11 weight 5 nexthop via 192.168.22.2 dev inet.22 weight 10
```
I'm getting around it with a unit calling `ip`, but it's not super clean and requires `IgnoreCarrierLoss=true` to not lose the route on carrier loss.
